title: Review round 1: Workspace scaffolding
description: Review round 1 for KITH-ob0 workspace scaffolding implementation.
notes: Confidence: 15% chance of missed bug. Review round 1 produced 10 findings: 2 real P1 (musl targets not installed, justfile missing musl recipes), 8 P3 rationale notes affirming correct decisions with no engineering complaint. The 8 P3 issues are documentation of good choices, not problems. Zero P0, zero P2. The 2 P1s are genuine maintainer-friction issues around musl cross-compile setup — real but not bugs in the scaffolding itself. No findings flag a bug in Cargo.toml structure, dependency graph, or workspace configuration. The scaffolding is sound. SEC7 verdict: running out of real complaints
